The same traces show checkout-owned client spans to oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct with 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled', and product-catalog's own GetProduct span metric recorded ~14.34 ERROR calls in the same 5 minutes, mirrored by frontend/frontend-proxy 500s. So the observed failures concentrate on the checkout -> product-catalog path. Among checkout's listed dependencies, payment returned explicit zero ERROR series for the last 5 minutes and cart/currency/shipping/email returned no ERROR series at all (unknown, not zero); dependency call latencies and product-catalog server latency were flat versus the immediately preceding equal 5-minute windows, and checkout's own PlaceOrder p95 fluctuated 73.5-223.75 ms across three equal windows, so no elevated-latency claim is supported. Whether the product-catalog failure mode is still active, its onset, and the responsibility for the feature flag are not established by this evidence, so the propagation story remains a hypothesis and the assessment is partial.

Those same traces contain checkout-owned client spans for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct carrying error=true, otel.status_code ERROR and description 'Error: Product Catalog Fail Feature Flag Enabled' (span de01d117485079c6 in trace bba16e134f9d6d3b336b9ccedb287ba7; span 616543cd91d920ed in trace f502de3917ad131fc7387031dcec491e).
